verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs explicitly confirm funnel-building as a core product analytics insight type (alongside trends, retention, paths), which can be saved/shared/alerted on, and filtering/breakdowns are implied by general insight-building capabilities. However, no evidence pack item explicitly details funnel-specific filter or breakdown UI/features, and community feedback raises concerns about query performance and scaling at analytics-heavy use, so confidence in full delivery is tempered.
